BRAND DECORATION · SEPARATE SUPPLY

Custom tumbler wrap decals & cup stickers

Source custom tumbler wrap decals and cup stickers separately from the drinkware. Review cup shape, artwork, application, material and required durability before approving the project.

Request a decal project review →

Specify the decal separately from the cup

Cup stickers and transfer decals can be supplied separately. A drinkware model reference helps review shape and application area; it does not mean cups are included in a decal quotation. State whether you need decals alone, application support or drinkware with decoration.

Cup shape and application area

Share the cup dimensions, curvature, substrate, application position and reference photos. A 40 oz tumbler decal must fit the actual vessel; capacity alone does not determine wrap dimensions.

Artwork and application requirements

Send artwork, colours, quantity and intended application. Agree the decal material, adhesive or transfer method, cleaning and durability requirements in the sample review or written specification.

From artwork to order approval

  1. Send the cup dimensions, artwork and quantity.
  2. Review the usable area, artwork scale and application approach.
  3. Arrange a project-specific sample review for fit and the required durability.
  4. Agree quantities, packing, cost and delivery in writing.

Screen printing and UV printing are different decoration options to compare for your project. Decals are not assumed suitable for every substrate or cleaning method.
